lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Agar aur jeete rehte, yahi intezaar hota
couplets.en: Had I lived longer, I would still be waiting.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Ajab apna haal hota jo visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: What a state I would be in if we ever came together.

lines: Kabhi jaan sadqe hoti, kabhi dil nisaar hota
couplets.en: Now I would lay down my life, now offer you my heart.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Koi mere dil se poochhe tere teer-e-neem-kash ko
couplets.en: Let someone ask my heart about the arrow you loosed from a half-drawn bow.

lines: Ye khalish kahaan se hoti jo jigar ke paar hota
couplets.en: Would it still ache like this if the arrow had passed clean through?

lines: Ye maza tha dil-lagi ka ke baraabar aag lagti
couplets.en: What pleasure there would be in love if we both burned alike.

lines: Na tujhe qaraar hota, na mujhe qaraar hota
couplets.en: Neither of us would know a moment of peace.

lines: Na tujhe qaraar hota
couplets.en: You would know no peace.

lines: Kabhi jaan sadqe hoti, kabhi dil nisaar hota
couplets.en: Now I would lay down my life, now offer you my heart.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Hue mar ke ham jo rusva, hue kyun na gharq-e-dariya
couplets.en: Death has made a disgrace of me, so why did I never drown?

lines: Na kabhi janaaza uthta, na kahin mazaar hota
couplets.en: No bier would have been lifted, and there would be no grave.

lines: Koi fitna ta-qayaamat na phir aashkaar hota
couplets.en: No trouble would ever come to light, even on Judgment Day.

lines: Tere dil pe kaash zaalim mujhe ikhtiyaar hota
couplets.en: If only I had some sway over that cruel heart of yours.

lines: Kabhi jaan sadqe hoti, kabhi dil nisaar hota
couplets.en: Now I would lay down my life, now offer you my heart.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Ye kahaan ki dosti hai ke bane hain dost naaseh
couplets.en: What kind of friendship is it when friends turn to preaching?

lines: Koi chaarasaaz hota, koi gham-gusaar hota
couplets.en: If only someone could ease the hurt, or sit with me in my grief.

lines: Na maza hai dushmani mein, na hai lutf dosti mein
couplets.en: There is no relish in enmity and no sweetness in friendship.

lines: Koi ghair ghair hota, koi yaar yaar hota
couplets.en: If only a rival were a rival and a friend a friend.

lines: Kabhi jaan sadqe hoti, kabhi dil nisaar hota
couplets.en: Now I would lay down my life, now offer you my heart.

lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke visaal-e-yaar hota
couplets.en: It was never my fate to be with you.

lines: Tere vaade par jiye ham, to ye jaan jhoot jaana
couplets.en: If your promise kept me alive, take that as proof I knew it was false.

lines: Ke khushi se mar na jaate agar aitbaar hota
couplets.en: Would I have lived through the joy if I had believed you?

lines: Tere vaade par sitamgar, abhi aur sabr karte
couplets.en: Cruel one, I would have waited a little longer on your promise.

lines: Agar apni zindagi ka hamein aitbaar hota
couplets.en: If only I could count on having time enough to live.

lines: Gham se marne mein kya hai, shab-e-gham buri bala hai
couplets.en: Dying of grief is a small thing beside living through its night.

lines: Agar ek baar hota
couplets.en: If it happened only once.

lines: Mujhe kya bura tha marna agar ek baar hota
couplets.en: I would hardly mind dying if I had to die only once.
